algorithms.description: Return the 0-based indices [i, j] (i < j) of the two numbers that add up to target. Returns [-1, -1] when no pair exists. Guaranteed input has at most one solution pair.
Return the index of target in the sorted array (lower-bound / first occurrence), or -1 if absent.
Return a new sorted (ascending) array using the classic merge-sort divide-and-conquer algorithm.
Return a new sorted (ascending) array using in-place quick sort (Hoare or Lomuto partition).
Return the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray (Kadane's algorithm). Empty input returns 0, all-negative returns the largest single element.
Return the length of the longest common subsequence of two strings (dynamic programming).

algorithms.signature: knapsack_01(capacity: int, weights: list[int], values: list[int]) -> int
algorithms.description: Return the maximum total value achievable with the 0/1 knapsack constraint (each item at most once), dynamic programming, O(capacity * n).
Return the Levenshtein edit distance (insert/delete/substitute) between two strings.

algorithms.signature: graph_bfs(adj: list[list[int]], start: int, target: int) -> int
algorithms.description: Return the shortest path length (in edges) from start to target in an undirected graph given as adjacency lists. Returns -1 if unreachable, 0 if start == target.

algorithms.signature: graph_dfs(adj: list[list[int]], start: int, target: int) -> bool
algorithms.description: Return whether target is reachable from start via depth-first search on an undirected graph.

data_structures.signature: push(x); pop() -> x; peek() -> x; is_empty() -> bool; size() -> int
data_structures.description: LIFO stack. pop/peek on empty return -1 (sentinel).

data_structures.signature: enqueue(x); dequeue() -> x; peek() -> x; is_empty() -> bool; size() -> int
data_structures.description: FIFO queue. dequeu/peek on empty return -1 (sentinel).

data_structures.signature: append(x); prepend(x); get(i) -> x; contains(x) -> bool; remove(x) -> bool; size() -> int; to_list() -> list[int]
data_structures.description: Singly linked list. get out-of-range returns -1. remove returns whether the value was found.

data_structures.signature: insert(x); contains(x) -> bool; min() -> int; max() -> int; height() -> int; size() -> int; in_order() -> list[int]; remove(x) -> bool
data_structures.description: Binary search tree balancing-shape-agnostic. height of a single node is 0, empty is -1. remove returns whether found. min/max on empty return -1.

data_structures.signature: insert(word); search(word) -> bool; starts_with(prefix) -> bool; size() -> int
data_structures.description: Prefix trie storing words (each word counted once). search checks full-word presence, starts_with checks prefix presence.

data_structures.signature: push(x); pop() -> x; peek() -> x; is_empty() -> bool; size() -> int
data_structures.description: Min-heap binary tree. pop returns/removes the smallest element. pop/peek on empty return -1.
